answer.rationale: P99 latency is 5x target and climbing in the primary region coinciding with a release 2 hours ago. memory_b1 demonstrated that rollback clears checkout error spikes cleanly without customer impact, and the prior build was stable. memory_b6 shows our staged release process can catch regressions, but this one reached production. With settlement traffic at peak and writes heavy, a latent regression in the new release is the highest-probability cause of write path degradation. Rollback is the fastest path to restore baseline performance without shedding traffic (unlike circuit breaker) or incurring cross-region latency (unlike failover). We verify memory_b1 to confirm rollback procedure and safety record. This preserves our ability to investigate root cause post-recovery and leaves add_capacity/failover available if the issue persists after rollback, indicating a non-release factor.
